raw_segments.text: My line, my line, gone, gone, what means that little word?
What death knell rings in it that old Ahab shakes as if he were the belfry?
The harpoon, too, toss over the litter there to see it.
The forged iron men, the white whales, no, no, no, blistered fool.
This hand did dart it, tis in the fish, aloft there, keep him nailed quick.
All hands to the rigging of the boats, collect the oars, harpooniers, the irons, the irons.
Hoist the royals higher, a pull on all the sheets.
I'll ten times girdle the unmeasured globe.
Yea, and dive straight through it, but I'll slay him yet.
